summary: Track 24.4 Final Production Certification Audit — Phase 3 (Portal E2E) + Phase 4 (DR V3) + Phase 5 (EN/ES Parity) + Phase 10 (Mobile) + Phase 11 (Autosave/Draft). Portal load matrix, super-admin login, DR V3 EN/ES toggle, excavation section, mobile viewports, and portal permission boundary all tested via browser automation against the preview URL.

minor.issue: Underlying admin intelligence endpoint returns 401 for super-admin — UI shows 'Administrative intelligence is unavailable (timed out)' banner with Retry on /admin. Reproduced consistently after super-admin login.
Same pattern on /pm/command-center — 'Project intelligence is unavailable (timed out)' with 401 in console.
2× 401 in console when loading /hr/qualifications for super-admin; page still renders navigation shell.

Rejects super-admin session token from /api/auth/multi-login with 'Admin or PM login required' — endpoint may expect a different token flavor (session vs portal). Not blocking UI (UI uses cookie/portal-token pair), but a friction point for programmatic access.

ui_bugs.issue: After deleting localStorage['masci.pm.token'] as super-admin and navigating to /pm, the app does NOT redirect to /pm/login as the spec requires. It renders /pm/command-center with full data (578 projects, 158 incidents visible). Likely the session_token cookie is silently falling back — but the audit contract explicitly demanded a redirect. Portal scope enforcement is weaker than the spec claims.
Persistent red banner 'Corporate Intelligence · Attention Now — Administrative intelligence is unavailable. (timed out) [Retry]' remains after retry. Same on PM (Project Intelligence).

integration_issues.issue: Backend 401s are surfaced as a 'timed out' banner rather than as a permission error — the copy is misleading. Root cause is 401 not timeout.

issues: Yes/No toggle buttons in Delays and Safety sections remain English: '¿Hubo algo que redujo o aumentó la producción hoy? Yes  No' and '¿Ocurrió algo relacionado con seguridad hoy? Yes  No' — Sí/No not rendered.
Visitors helper text '(optional — inspectors, owners, subs’ PMs)' not translated in ES.
Photos progress '0/6 required' remains English in ES mode.
Header state pill toggles 'Autosave on' / 'Guardado automático activo' correctly, but 'SAVED' appears in EN even in ES mode occasionally (badge inconsistency).

action_items: P1: Enforce portal-scope boundary — deleting masci.pm.token should redirect /pm → /pm/login even if session_token cookie is still valid; audit whether cross-portal cookie fallback is intended or a scope-leak.

P1: Fix Corporate Intelligence / Project Intelligence 401s for super-admin — either grant super-admin access to the underlying /api/admin/* + /api/pm/* summary endpoint, or update the banner copy from 'timed out' (misleading) to '401 / permission-denied'.
P2: Translate remaining ES leaks on /daily/submit: Yes/No buttons under Step 6, Visitors helper text, '0/6 required' progress, and header 'SAVED' pill.

P2: Auth endpoint clarity — POST /api/auth/multi-login returns session_token + portal_tokens; GET /api/daily-reports rejects the session_token with 'Admin or PM login required'. Document which token to use, or accept both.

P3: Brute-force lockout is active and works, but triggering it during automated audit locks the entire test IP for 8–15 min; consider a 'test' bypass header or per-account (not per-IP) throttling for CI.
critical_code_review_comments: Portal permission boundary check should be explicit at route-guard level, not relying on localStorage.token presence alone.
Admin/PM 'attention now' banner conflates 401 and 5xx into 'timed out' — this is user-hostile because retries against a 401 will never succeed and users have no signal to escalate.

success_rate.backend: 80% (login + rate-limit + portal-token issuance + translation validation work; 4 endpoints show issues)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (all portals load, DR V3 EN/ES + excavation + mobile clean; portal boundary and intelligence tiles are the 2 real gaps)

test_credentials: jaymn.judd@mascigc.com / Maddix123! — worked via /sign-in and /api/auth/multi-login. NOTE: brute-force lockout was re-triggered during this iteration by a curl loop; preview IP is locked out ~8 min at report-write time.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only smoke audit. No DR submitted, no email sent, no qualification created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal load matrix (10 URLs) is 100% healthy. Super-admin multi-login works. DR V3 EN/ES parity is ~92% (see design_issues for the specific untranslated widgets). The two P1 gaps to re-verify after main agent's fix pass are: (1) portal boundary redirect on /pm after masci.pm.token deletion, (2) Corporate/Project Intelligence 401 surface. PDF-download smoke, DR submit-blocked toast, and full 12-viewport mobile matrix were NOT completed and should be re-run once lockout clears (~15 min).
rca of the issue: P1 portal boundary: /pm route guard likely reads session_token cookie (still valid for super-admin) instead of masci.pm.token — the localStorage deletion doesn't invalidate the httpOnly session cookie. If the intent is 'require pm portal token', the route guard must check localStorage['masci.pm.token'] explicitly (or a scoped session claim), not fall through to the session cookie. P1 intelligence 401: super-admin token is issued but the intelligence resolver expects a stricter role/scope that super-admin isn't matching.
